name: Ashwall InfoShadow Broker's Complete Set
description:
The info broker's full underworld look: a slim-cut collarless shirt in deep plum shot-silk — understated wealth, no logos — beneath a structured mid-length coat in matte charcoal wool-synth with hidden interior panels for data storage media and slim weapons. Trousers are tailored dark slate with a subtle iridescent weave visible only at close range. Shoes are soft-soled, pointed-toe oxfords in black bioskin — silent on tile and concrete alike.

Accessories are deliberate: one matte-chrome data-link bracelet on the left wrist, a minimal neural port ring at the temple, and a narrow-brim hat in pressed felt that obscures the face on overhead surveillance. No visible aug hardware, though the coat accommodates a spinal rig under the back panel.
functionality: Hidden interior coat panels for data storage and slim weapons, spinal rig channel under back panel, soft bioskin soles for near-silent movement, neural port integration at temple ring, surveillance-obscuring hat brim angle.
what_it_says: I know things you need, I dress like I don't need you, and neither of those facts is an accident.
story_hooks: The interior panel of the coat contains a data chip that hasn't been opened in three years — the broker doesn't know who planted it.
The bioskin oxfords are traceable to a Spire tannery that only sells to Tier 5 clients; how the broker got them is its own story.
Someone in the same hat and coat configuration was photographed at two separate crime scenes six months apart — different person, same outfit.
